STRIDE — NETLIFY EDITION

DEPLOY FOR FREE
1. Use a free Netlify account and keep the Free plan selected.
2. Open https://app.netlify.com/drop and upload Stride-Netlify.zip directly.
   You can also extract the archive and upload the folder containing index.html.
3. If Netlify creates a temporary/unclaimed project, claim it into your account.
4. Follow the project screen to publish it if required. Use the supplied netlify.app address.
5. Open the new address on your phone and Add to Home Screen.

No build command, API key, backend, database, Git repository, or ChatGPT subscription is needed.
This ZIP contains the app source and all deployable assets; keep it for future edits.

MOVE EXISTING LOGS
In the old Stride app, Settings > Export backup.
In the new Netlify app, Settings > Restore backup. Restore on the phone/browser you plan to use.
Data is stored locally per browser and website address. It does not sync between phones or browsers.
The hosted app can be visited by others, but their browser does not receive your local fitness logs.

REMINDERS
Settings > save reminder times > Download reminder calendar.
Import the .ics into your calendar and enable calendar notifications.
These reminders work when Stride is closed. Open-page browser alerts require the page to remain active.
If you already imported reminders for the old address, remove the old calendar before importing the new one.

FREE PLAN
Netlify's Free plan currently includes 300 monthly credits. Stay on Free and avoid paid upgrades.
Hosting usage limits still apply; monitor Usage & billing in your Netlify account.
Pricing verified 17 October 2026: https://www.netlify.com/pricing/
Manual deployment guide: https://docs.netlify.com/deploy/create-deploys/

Your health logs are not bundled in this download. No private Sites metadata or credentials are included.
